Float Clamp

Source: R/raymath_functions.R
float_clamp.Rd

Float Clamp

Usage

float_clamp(value, min, max)

Arguments

value

A number.

min

A number.

max

A number.

Value

A number

See also

Other float functions: float_equals(), float_lerp(), float_normalize(), float_remap(), float_wrap(), text_to_float()

Examples

float_clamp(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
#> [1] 0
